speaker: Gabriel W. Reid
role: Second Counselor in the Sunday School General Presidency
title: You Are Good Enough to Teach
summary: Brother Reid teaches that anyone can teach the gospel, because the Master Teacher promises to make His teachers into who He needs, and the heart of His teaching is love. He draws on Christ calling ordinary fishermen, the sons of Mosiah, his childhood in Leone, American Samoa, where his parents and Primary teachers under a mango tree taught him by loving him, and the resurrected Savior ministering one by one in the Americas. He asks teachers to use the new 25-minute lessons to help class members connect to the Savior, and to come unto, learn of, and love the Master Teacher so they can love those they teach.
